source_claim: The official Oreimo character directory and second-season official music/episode credits identify nine campaign members as fictional characters in the series.
notes: The official anime character directory (https://www.oreimo-anime.com/1st/chara/index.html) profiles Kirino, Kyousuke, Kuroneko/Gokou Ruri, Saori Bajeena/Makishima Saori, Ayase, Kanako, and Manami. Official second-season music and disc credits (https://www.oreimo-anime.com/sp/music/) identify Bridget Evans and Gokou Tamaki by name as in-series performers. `hanazawa_kana` is withheld because the checked official material identifies Kana Hanazawa as the voice performer for Kuroneko, not a fictional character in this work. `gokou_hinata` is also withheld: the checked first-party character roster and credits did not establish a direct official identity route for that exact member, so no relation is asserted. The copyright root `ore_no_imouto_ga_konna_ni_kawaii_wake_ga_nai` is present in the tracked confirmed v3 baseline.
